title: Table theme surface colors live in themeDefinitions JSON, under components.table
answers: Where do I edit the actual hex values for table header/row/selected-row colors?
Which file controls the visual-refresh table selected-row color?
How do classic vs visual-refresh table colors differ and where are they defined?
body: The resolved colors for table header background, borders, striped/hover/selected row backgrounds are defined per theme in packages/grafana-data/src/themes/themeDefinitions/*.json under the `table` block (e.g. visual_refresh_dark.json and visual_refresh_light.json have `table.rowSelectedBackground`). These are validated against the createComponents schema (packages/grafana-data/src/themes/createComponents.ts) and consumed by TableNG via theme.components.table — not computed in component code. To tune a table color for a specific theme, edit the matching themeDefinitions JSON file rather than styles.ts.
applies: grafana-data theme definitions and anything consuming theme.components.table

search: Table theme surface colors—header background, borders, striped/hover/selected row backgrounds—are defined per theme in packages/grafana-data/src/themes/themeDefinitions JSON files (e.g. visual_refresh_dark.json, visual_refresh_light.json) under the `table` block (e.g. `table.rowSelectedBackground`). These colors are validated against the createComponents schema and consumed by TableNG via `theme.components.table`, not computed in component style code. To tune a table color for a specific theme, edit the corresponding themeDefinitions JSON file rather than styles.ts. This applies to grafana-data theme definitions and any code consuming `theme.components.table`.
